displayedInputs.question: What shape does the lateral surface of a cone form when unfolded?

What is the volume of a prism with base area 20 and height 4?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

What is the volume of a cylinder with base area 10 and height 6?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

What is the volume of a cone with base area 9 and height 3?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

What is the ratio of the volume of a cone to that of a cylinder with the same base area and height?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)

[Figure 1](attached-image-9)

When the radius of a sphere becomes 3 times its original value, how many times its original surface area does the sphere have?

[Figure 1](attached-image-10)

What is the volume ratio for a sphere of radius 1 and a sphere of radius 2? Divide the larger volume by the smaller volume.

[Figure 1](attached-image-11)
